The test image shows a split soybean stem being held by hand. Key features:
- Bleached white/gray exterior on the stem
- Internal pith appears discolored/rotted
- Fibrous, dried-out tissue
- Possible sclerotia visible inside

This strongly suggests White Mold (Sclerotinia stem rot) — the classic bleached white stem with internal sclerotia. Let me confirm with one reference image.

The reference confirms White Mold: bleached/tan stem with sclerotia (black bodies). The test image matches closely — bleached white/gray stem exterior, hollowed fibrous interior consistent with Sclerotinia stem rot. The stem has been split to reveal the characteristic internal decay.
